baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full construction links the believer's utterance, his own people, expected harm, likeness, a severe day, and assembled factions.
baseline_models.mechanism: An insider voices expected harm for his group and maps their present course onto a severe occurrence associated with a coalition gathered around one view.

activation_trace.role: Voiced expression makes the warning an overt speech act.
Heart-settling assent identifies the speaker's committed standpoint.
The human group is both the speaker's affiliation and the warning's audience.
Expectation of marked harm supplies the warning's prospective force.
Likeness maps the present danger onto a prior analogue.
A day understood as a severe occurrence compresses a crisis into one temporal label.
A coalition formed around a shared position supplies the social shape of the analogue.

changed_reading.before: A believer says that he fears a bad day for his people.
changed_reading.after: An insider warns that his people's present alignment can issue in a coalition-shaped calamity analogous to an earlier severe occurrence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person fear is directed over the addressees, and it is converted into speech through a cautionary likeness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker does more than report an emotion: sincere concern externalizes private apprehension as a lesson intended to awaken precaution in the group.

activation_trace.role: Sincere concern carried through saying makes the utterance an act of care.
Fear induced in others supplies the warning's precautionary effect, beyond the speaker's own fear.
The likeness as a lesson turns remembered disaster into usable warning.

changed_reading.before: The sentence is a personal confession of anxiety.
changed_reading.after: The confession is a protective intervention: the speaker lends his fear to the group so that an analogue can function as preventive instruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believer takes up Pharaoh's first-person fear formula and the contested language of right guidance, but relocates danger from Moses to the coalition's own conduct and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Overt saying anchors the focus as a deliberate counter-utterance.
Expected harm is the shared semantic payload whose source the two speakers contest.
Pharaoh's voiced claim supplies the earlier matching speech frame.
The identical first-person expectation of harm supplies the formula later reversed.
Pharaoh's claim to a straight path establishes one pole of rival guidance.
The believer applies the same straight-guidance label to the opposing path, confirming the counter-speech mechanism.

structural_cues: 40:26 and 40:30 repeat the same first-person fear frame under rival speakers while changing the feared threat.
40:29 and 40:38 place the same path-of-right-guidance claim in Pharaoh's mouth and then the believer's.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired fear formulas and paired guidance claims; I infer that the later insider strategically answers the ruler in his own protective register. A live alternative is unmarked narrative parallel rather than deliberate rhetorical appropriation.

changed_reading.before: The believer independently announces fear of a historical kind of disaster.
changed_reading.after: He counters Pharaoh's security rhetoric from within, returning its fear formula while identifying Pharaoh-like coalition behavior, not Moses, as the real danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith previously held under cover crosses into voiced, repeated, and memorable public advocacy; the focus ayah marks a threshold between inward security and exposed speech.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the inward commitment that is about to acquire a public voice.
Audible expression is the crossing from held conviction into intervention.
Concealment establishes the pressure boundary that the focus speech breaches.
The paired believing identity and hidden faith distinguish settled conviction from its prior social visibility.
Repeated overt utterance shows that the warning develops into sustained public advocacy.
A saying that circulates among people gives the voiced warning a predicted afterlife in communal memory.

structural_cues: 40:28 identifies a believing man who conceals his faith before the extended speeches.
40:30 and 40:38 repeat the narrator's explicit believer-said frame, and 40:44 projects remembrance of what he says.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed faith followed by extended overt speech; I infer a disclosure threshold at the focus. He could alternatively remain socially unidentified while presenting prudential arguments, so the degree of public self-disclosure remains open.

changed_reading.before: A known believer voices a warning.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the risky emergence of a previously covered commitment into durable counter-speech before the speaker's own ruling group.

context_deltas.mechanism: Likeness is sharpened into a repeatable historical process: aligned groups oppose messengers, persist in an established habit, and arrive at the same consequence along a running way already passed through earlier peoples.

activation_trace.role: Explicit similarity opens the focus event to pattern mapping.
Coalition around a shared stance supplies the recurring process's social unit.
The earlier coalition occurrence supplies the concrete cycle of collective opposition and consequence.
Repeated likeness explicitly extends the focus analogy across named prior peoples.
Continuous habit converts resemblance of outcomes into recurrence of conduct.
A running, followed way supplies the surah-wide closure of the recurrence schema.
Passing time and vanished generations locate that running way in repeated historical succession.

structural_cues: 40:31 directly apposes the focus simile with the continuing habit of Noah's people, Ad, Thamud, and those after them.
40:82-85 repeats the survey of prior stronger peoples and closes with an established way already passed among servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies likeness, habitual conduct, prior generations, and a running way; I infer a causal recurrence from coalition formation through opposition to consequence. A live alternative treats these as outcome analogies without a single procedural cycle.

changed_reading.before: The people face a disaster merely comparable in severity to a past day.
changed_reading.after: They are entering a reproducible coalition-collapse process whose conduct and outcome have already run through successive peoples.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation lets one day-language fold two temporal horizons together: remembered coalition disasters become anticipatory images of the final day of mutual calling, flight, and failed protection.

activation_trace.role: A day as a severe occurrence permits the temporal label to carry more than a calendar date.
The renewed similarity phrase secures the historical horizon in named peoples.
A second severe day, introduced by the repeated fear formula, opens the final horizon.
Raised calling gives that second day its public acoustic mechanism.
Repetition keeps the severe-day frame active while its scene is specified.
Turning the back supplies flight as the motion inside the projected day.
Protective restraint, explicitly unavailable, makes historical collapse prefigure final exposure.

structural_cues: 40:31 continues the historical comparison, while 40:32 repeats the full address-and-fear frame with another day.
40:33 immediately renders that second day as backward flight with no protector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent historical and final-day warnings under repeated syntax; I infer that the second day retrospectively colors the focus day while preserving both horizons. The live alternative is a simple list of two distinct dangers with no temporal folding.

changed_reading.before: The day of the factions refers only to a past historical disaster.
changed_reading.after: The phrase becomes a temporal hinge: past coalition collapses are remembered as previews of the final day of calling, flight, and failed refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning attempts to place the group behind protection by awakening caution; the sequence tests human aid, declares the absence of a protector, moves to entrusted agency, and culminates in actual warding of the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Sincere care makes speaking itself the speaker's offered protection.
Induced fear functions as a prompt to take precautions before harm arrives.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail frames the collective rescue problem immediately before the focus.
Overpowering severity is the concrete harm from which the speech seeks protection.
Withholding and preservation define the protective function precisely by their announced absence.
Returning the affair to another in reliance shifts the warning's outcome beyond the speaker's control.
Actual warding of harm resolves the protection motif for the speaker even though his people resist it.

structural_cues: 40:29 asks who can help us from overpowering force, preserving the believer's inclusive concern for the group.
40:33 denies any protector; 40:44 entrusts the affair; 40:45 then states that God warded the speaker from their plotting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the aid question, absent protector, delegation, and actual warding; I infer that the focus warning pragmatically tries to protect by producing timely caution. A live alternative restricts protection to the later fate of the speaker and treats no protective intention as encoded in the warning.

changed_reading.before: The believer compassionately describes a danger.
changed_reading.after: His utterance is attempted warding: he tries to shield his people through timely fear, then entrusts the failed intervention and is himself shielded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus saying-root to q-l-l and does not replace the ordinary meaning of saying. It remains anchored in that explicit split inventory, visible fear, prior concealment, and later repeated speech. Downstream prose should present it only as an embodied or acoustic resonance of precarious public utterance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus saying-word through mapped_root_id root_001251, coupled with the focus fear-word.

activation_trace.role: The secondary target's tremor from fear gives bodily instability to the moment of saying.
Fear becoming visible on a person couples expected harm to embodied exposure.
Held-back voice supplies the pressure from which the focus utterance emerges.
Renewed audible saying shows the precarious voice persisting after its first emergence.

changed_reading.before: The verb of saying is a neutral narrative introduction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the saying is a trembling break in concealment: a held voice enters public space under fear and remains there.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the punishment-example branch of m-th-l is not the direct syntactic value of the focus noun. It remains anchored in the supplied branch and in 40:5's exact faction, attempted taking, punitive taking, and punishment sequence. Downstream prose should call it a punitive echo or secondary resonance, never translate the focus phrase as mutilation or punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus likeness-word's punishment-example branch together with the focus factions-word.

activation_trace.role: Exemplary punishment lets the comparison faintly carry the making of a warning-example.
The assembled coalition is the social body exposed to becoming that example.
The matching coalition occurrence fixes the resonance to the named historical analogue.
The paired attempted taking and punitive taking supplies the reversal by which persecutors become those taken to account.
Punishment following wrongdoing completes the mechanism that makes the coalition cautionary.

changed_reading.before: The phrase only compares one day with another.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified secondary echo, it warns that coalition aggressors can themselves be turned into the exemplary image by which later groups are warned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because decrement belongs to a form-distant branch of kh-w-f, while the focus verb ordinarily denotes fear. It remains worth carrying because the focus fear is placed against present dominion and dominance, then the surah shows greater number and strength failing to suffice. Downstream prose should render erosion as a material analogy for what is feared, not as a lexical replacement for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The decrement branch of the focus fear-root, joined to the severe-event branch of its day-word.

activation_trace.role: Taking away by degrees recasts the feared event as erosion of the group's present supports.
The severe occurrence supplies the concentrated episode through which erosion becomes collapse.
Present sovereignty supplies the possession exposed to being taken away.
Current superiority supplies the elevated state from which the group can fall.
Competitive superiority in number supplies a historical support that nevertheless failed.
Concentrated strength supplies another apparently durable support exposed to collapse.
Sufficiency, negated in the source ayah, marks accumulated power's inability to preserve itself.

changed_reading.before: The speaker fears an external calamity arriving against the group.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, he fears a day that strips away today's sovereignty, dominance, number, and strength until the coalition cannot sustain itself.

strongest_changes: The believer reverses Pharaoh's own fear formula and contests his claim to right guidance.
The focus marks concealed faith crossing into sustained and memorable public counter-speech.
The simile expands into both a repeatable coalition-collapse process and a hinge between historical and final-day exposure.
The warning functions as attempted protection, followed by entrusted agency and actual protection of the speaker.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence connected the focus's tightly repeated formulas to distant closure in an established historical way, while the split q-w-l mapping and form-distant branches preserved embodied, punitive, and erosive resonances that a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The final day in 40:32-33 may color the focus day retrospectively, or it may remain a strictly separate second warning.
The concealed believer's speech may disclose his identity publicly, or it may preserve some plausible deniability while exposing his argument.
The q-l-l tremor, m-th-l punishment-example, and kh-w-f decrement readings are branch-backed resonances, not secure lexical substitutions.
